description: Emerson DeltaV DCS Modbus register map (VERIFIED)
notes: CRITICAL: DeltaV uses LITTLE-ENDIAN word order for 32-bit values (LSW first, MSW second). This differs from many devices. VIM2 handles byte manipulation automatically; serial cards require manual manipulation in control strategy.
source: VIM2 User Manual (MYNAH/Emerson, IOD-4111), Manual Supplement 00809-0300-4570 Rev BA

example_float.description: Example 32-bit float (LSW at addr 0, MSW at addr 1)

extended_info.word_order_detail: When DeltaV reads a 32-bit register, it assigns the 16-bit word in the first Modbus register to the LSB data and the second to the MSB

address_scheme.note: Start addresses specified as offset without leading prefix
address_scheme.example: Register 40001 = Start address 0 for Holding Registers

_source_verified: Verified: DeltaV VIM2 Modbus TCP interface confirmed at emerson.com and modbus.org
